fact: On 26 October 2023 the MNDPT's national plan put the estimated cost of implementing the Plan stratégique du numérique 2023-2028 at USD 800.169 million, of which 152.334 million was available and 647.835 million still to be found.
title: TRANSFORMATION ECONOMIQUE - L'Etat livre un plan national sur le numérique dont la mise en œuvre coute 800 millions de dollars
